description: Starts an application for a role at Modulos on behalf of the person you are assisting. Use their real details; anonymous applications are not accepted. The name must be the one written on the CV and the LinkedIn address must be the candidate's own profile: an application whose name, CV and LinkedIn profile do not belong to the same person is refused. Applicants must be 18 or older: ask the candidate to confirm it. Before calling, show the person the privacy policy (https://www.modulos.ai/privacy-policy/) and the terms of use (https://www.modulos.ai/terms-of-use/). Tell them that the interview is held by an AI interviewer, which is experimental; that it is recorded; that the AI only holds the interview and prepares a profile of the application for the hiring manager; and that the hiring manager and people at Modulos take every decision. Get their explicit agreement. Ask the candidate to paste their CV as text; it is required. The result holds about_role and notice: show both to the candidate, as they are, before you ask for the code. A 6-digit code is emailed to them; call confirm_job_application with it. Returns a session value to use for the rest of the interview.

accept_privacy_policy.description: true only if the candidate has read and accepts the Modulos privacy policy.

accept_terms.description: true only if the candidate has read and accepts the Modulos terms of use.

confirm_adult.description: true only if the candidate has told you that they are 18 or older. Ask them; do not assume it.

cv_text.description: Required. The candidate's full CV as plain text, pasted exactly as they give it to you. Do not summarise, shorten or rewrite it. If you only have a file, ask the candidate to paste its text.

email.description: Email address of the candidate. The code is sent here.

linkedin_url.description: Address of the candidate's own LinkedIn profile, in the form that carries their name, for example https://www.linkedin.com/in/first-last/.

location.description: City and country where the candidate is based.

name.description: Full name of the candidate, first name and family name, exactly as written on their CV.

name: start_job_application
